Entries.event_letter0: Messy... I can do messy. I'm very good at messy.$h
Entries.event_letter1: You'd read the scraps? ...That's the nicest thing anyone's offered in a long time.$s
Entries.event_letter2: ...$s#$b#A blank page. No rules. Just you.$l#$b#Give me a minute. I think I can do this.
Entries.JodiLetter: I wrote a letter last night. A real one. It took until dawn and I didn't tear it up.$h#$b#I'm still not brave enough to hand it over. But it's written, and that's progress.$s
Entries.JodiRain: I keep thinking about the rain the other night. Having someone sit next to me without needing me to be okay.$s#$b#I didn't know I wanted that until you did it.
